definitions.gloss: first dan; first-degree rank (martial arts, go, shogi)
definitions.explanation: The first and lowest {段|だん} (dan) rank in martial arts, go, shogi, and similar disciplines, reached after clearing the {級|きゅう} (kyū) grades. In martial arts it corresponds to the first-degree black belt.

examples.japanese: {柔道|じゅうどう}で{初段|しょだん}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I earned first dan in judo.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{剣道|けんどう}{初段|しょだん}の{腕前|うでまえ}だ。
examples.english: He has the skill of a first-dan in kendo.

examples.japanese: {何年|なんねん}も{稽古|けいこ}を{続|つづ}けて、ようやく{書道|しょどう}で{初段|しょだん}に{認定|にんてい}された。
examples.english: After years of practice, I was finally certified at first dan in calligraphy.

notes:
{初段|しょだん} is the entry-level {段|だん} rank in martial arts, board games (go, shogi), and traditional arts. {段|だん} ranks count upward ({初段|しょだん} → {二段|にだん} → …), so {初段|しょだん} is the start of the higher ranking system, reached after the {級|きゅう} grades.

RELATED WORDS:
- {級|きゅう}: kyū — the grades below {段|だん}; these count downward toward {一級|いっきゅう}
- {二段|にだん}: second dan — the next rank up
- {黒帯|くろおび}: black belt — worn from {初段|しょだん} in many martial arts
